title: Repair Set-Aside Draws: Inspections, Holdback, Deadline and Completion
content:
Repair draws under Set-Aside Accounts are paid only from plans that make repair disbursements — the Repair Set-Aside — and always by check to the contractor named on the invoice.

## 1. Request on file

A repair draw is paid only against a repair draw request on file for that set-aside whose request status is received and which carries an inspection reference. Every repair draw needs an inspection report on file, as the plan requires. Each repair draw request is paid at most once.

## 2. Completion deadline

Repair disbursements are made only when the repair draw request is received no later than the plan's repair completion months, in calendar months, after the set-aside was established.

- **Clock start:** the established date of the set-aside, as the set-aside record shows.
- **Counting:** the deadline is the same day number in the month that many calendar months after the established date, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist.
- **Comparison:** the request's received date must be no later than the deadline; a request received on the deadline itself still qualifies.
- **When missed:** a request received after the deadline is declined as past the repair deadline; the remaining repair funds stay reserved and the case passes to Cedarline's property preservation unit, which these rules do not cover.

| Hypothetical established date (12-month plan) | Deadline | Received on deadline | Received the day after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 May 2027 | 14 May 2028 | Qualifies | Declined |
| 29 February 2028 | 28 February 2029 (no 29th) | Qualifies | Declined (1 March 2029) |

## 3. Progress draw

A progress draw is paid only when the inspection found at least the plan's minimum percent of the work complete and fewer than the plan's maximum number of progress draws have been paid; otherwise it is declined as an insufficient inspection. It pays the invoiced billed amount less the plan's holdback percent, rounded to the cent, and limited to the set-aside balance.

## 4. Final draw

The final draw is paid only when the inspection found the work 100.00 percent complete; otherwise it is declined as an insufficient inspection. It pays the final invoice's billed amount plus the holdback to date, limited to the set-aside balance. The holdback to date is the sum, over the set-aside's progress draw requests whose status is paid, of each request's billed amount less the amount actually paid against it.

## 5. Numbering, release and closing

- The repair draw number is the number of repair disbursements already paid from the set-aside, plus one.
- After the final draw is paid, the unused balance is released on the same date, with the reason "repair completed", to the plan's destination for unused repair funds, and the set-aside is closed on that date.

## Worked figures on hypothetical inputs (plan holdback 10.0 percent)

| Draw | Invoice | Paid | Held back |
|---|---|---|---|
| Progress draw 1 (60 percent complete) | 3,000.00 | 2,700.00 | 300.00 |
| Progress draw 2 (85 percent complete) | 2,000.00 | 1,800.00 | 200.00 |
| Final draw (100.00 percent complete) | 1,500.00 | 2,000.00 (1,500.00 plus 500.00 holdback) | — |

If the set-aside held 9,000.00 at the start, 2,500.00 remains after the final draw and is released the same day.
